summary: Form 6-K filed by Prudential plc reports routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMR). Specifically, CEO Anil Wadhwani acquired 3,406 ordinary shares at HKD 121.20 per share on 15 May 2026 as dividend reinvestment under the Annual Incentive Plan. No special-situation event: no M&A, activist campaign, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review. This is a standard PDMR shareholding notification required under UK market rules, filed as a foreign private issuer report. No deal terms, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle applicable.
